Support

Rosie is here to help

A grown-up can write to us about a device, a browser, or anything that felt off in a game. Store details will be added here when our games launch as apps.

Email support@pinkrynostudios.com (leaves this website, a grown-up answers first). The link asks a short multiplication question first, so a small child does not open the mail app. The address is support@pinkrynostudios.com.

Common questions

The parental gate

Links that leave this website ask a grown-up to answer a short multiplication question first. That includes email.

The question is a speed bump so a small child does not wander off to another site. It is not an account, and we do not save the answer.

Deleting data

We do not collect personal data, so there is no profile to delete. Game progress is saved only in your browser, and clearing this site's data erases it.

The full explanation is in the privacy policy.

Something went wrong

Email support@pinkrynostudios.com (leaves this website, a grown-up answers first) and tell us the game, the device and browser, and what happened. Please do not send a child's name, photo, or precise location. A grown-up's first name is enough.
